images.subject: A metal mining complex, one towering multi-level industrial building built directly around the wide dark mouth of a mine tunnel cut into the cliff face, with one massive conveyor carrying raw ore out of the tunnel.
images.detail: Thick veins of raw silver and copper metal run through the exposed rock around the tunnel mouth.
images.state: Far-future high-tech mining machinery in active use, with composite panels and polished metal coated in fine grey rock dust, and illuminated light strips.
images.site: It is built into the foot of a towering dark neutral grey rock cliff heavily covered with thick white snow and ice, with the ground all around blanketed in deep white snow and snowdrifts, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.

images.view: High aerial view from a distance, with the whole research complex visible inside the frame.
images.subject: A research laboratory complex built around one immense glass dome, with glowing scientific instruments visible inside it.
images.detail: A ring of slender antennas surrounds the dome.
images.site: It stands on a flat plateau blanketed in deep white snow and snowdrifts at the top of a towering dark neutral grey rock cliff heavily covered with thick white snow and ice, open to the sky, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.

images.subject: A deuterium synthesis plant built around one cluster of giant spherical pressure tanks.
images.detail: Thick insulated pipes run from the tanks down into the sea.
images.site: It stands on a broad platform on baked terracotta-red earth at the foot of a towering scorched dark basalt cliff with a few thin glowing orange lava cracks that plunges straight into a dark slate-grey sea with heavy swell and thick white steam rising from its surface, on a sun-baked lifeless alien planet of bare scorched rock, with thick columns of volcanic smoke rising in the distance.
